decision: Meiku remains a single-vault product. Password and six-digit PIN unlock the same client-side vault; the unreliable Passkey/WebAuthn PRF quick unlock is removed.
rationale: The product owner prefers the reliable PIN flow. PIN is a local vault-unlock convenience, not a server account or an additional server-side sign-in method.
consequences: The standard account authentication profile does not apply.
New PIN blobs use one million PBKDF2-SHA-256 iterations and AES-GCM.
The server write secret is plaintext only in sessionStorage and may be persisted only inside the PIN-encrypted credential blob.
Legacy four-to-six-digit PIN blobs remain readable for compatibility and prompt the user to create a new six-digit PIN.
Deprecated passkey metadata and wrapped-password blobs are removed on startup.
Vault-specific negative security tests and the time-bounded OVR-001 review remain mandatory.
